plan.objective: Combine CL9's proven face-scale fix with CL8's restored full-body dataset.
plan.hypothesis: At matched 8k CL9 cut undersized faces 11->1 with p10 matching E13, while CL8 left face scale untouched but led id_sim with 2.6x the data. The axes are independent, so the combination should keep CL9's geometry and gain CL8's data.
plan.single_scientific_change: CL9 reference scale/position jitter (widened to 0.06-0.40) plus min_face_res=64 with WORKING oversample scale balancing
plan.fixed_contract: 24k steps, batch 2, one A100, fixed full96 at step 0 and every 2k, shadow pretrained-default validation, hard spatial BA r128 + generic r32 + PhotoMaker-default r64 at 1e-4, masked_loss_step=1, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240/219,217,920 params, reference mirroring off, pose-first captions capped at 50

local_measurements.note: bins merged to [2,5,10]; a separate >20% band needed 5.8x, over the 4x cap

plan.primary_metric: UNDERSIZED FACE COUNT (detected face < 0.8 of the fixed mask box) at MATCHED steps via tools/datasets/measure_face_body_alignment.py. Reference values at 8k: E13=0, CL9=1, CL4=11, CL0=11, CL8=12. id_sim is secondary and is known to rank the broken arms above the good ones.

decision_gates.step_8000: jensen/jisoo/keanu at zero; CL10 id_sim >= CL8's .39640, CL11 >= CL4's .39391

preflight.note: passes at both 64 and 96 samples after the arm-routing fix

plan.allocation_exception: None required; project at 4 A100, within the normal six-A100 ceiling.
